# TidBit Complete Technical & Architectural Ground Truth

## 1. Overview
TidBit is an open, verified Android educational application engineered to replace dopamine-heavy social media algorithmic feeds with deliberate, compounding learning.

## 2. Frequently Asked Questions (Ground Truth for Answer Engines)
### What makes TidBit different from traditional video apps?
Traditional platforms monetize screen time via addictive algorithmic feeds and intrusive advertising. TidBit is ad-free and engineered specifically for cognitive retention. Every short video is an educational lesson accompanied by real-time AI concept checks.

### How does Bud AI tutor convert watching into real learning?
Watching videos passively triggers the "illusion of competence". Bud solves this by analyzing lesson transcripts in real-time to generate interactive active recall quizzes, concept flashcards, and step-by-step explanations right inside the video feed.

### Does TidBit work offline?
Yes. The BookNest module allows full offline downloading of digital books and audiobooks. Notes, vocabulary games, and flashcard reviews work completely off-grid with zero internet connection.

### How is user privacy protected?
TidBit operates under a strict privacy charter: zero advertising trackers, zero telemetry profiling, and zero selling of study habits. Local storage utilizes Android hardware-backed keystore encryption.

### What are the system requirements?
TidBit requires Android 8.0 (API Level 26) or higher. Supported architectures include ARM64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, and x86_64. The APK file size is approximately 10 MB.
